'''Mogoshyn''' was a run-down [[Factory world/Legends|industrial world]] located in the [[Mogoshyn system/Legends|Mogoshyn system]], a part of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Planet/Legends|world]] lay between the [[Betshish system/Legends|Betshish]] and [[Kushibah system/Legends|Kushibah systems]] on the [[Pinooran Spur/Legends|Pinooran Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mogoshyn was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-5.<ref name="TEA" />
